mathematics.assertion_tested: Independent principal signed and positive order-four Padé examples, C08 generic degree-drop example, and exact low-degree Fourier phases plus selected window values.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: mpmath at 80 decimal working digits; exact SymPy Q(i)[w].
mathematics.conventions: Padé denominator q0=1; roots of x^4+q1*x^3+q2*x^2+q3*x+q4 are effective nodes. Fourier convention exp(-i*w*y)/sqrt(2*pi), centered ambiguity exp(+i*eta*y).
non_claims: No universal arithmetic signed support, nonbreakdown, simple-root, or stability theorem.
Numerical values and roots are not interval enclosures.
No full source proof re-audit or Lean build.
